The following event took place in '''403 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] scouting [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] [[Commerce (starship)|''Commerce'']] disappears while attempting to make an orbital scan of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], in the [[Luire system]]. Some CSA survey ships are later that year able to confirm that the planet's atmosphere and magnetic field made conventional scanning or observation of the world impossible, and the ''Commerce'' is never heard from again.<ref name="Galaxy of Intrigue">{{WizCite|story=The Perfect Storm|book=Galaxy of Intrigue}}</ref>
